project: (note) Unified cross-project messaging root is ~/.fah/messages/, replacing per-project ~/.fah/sessions/<cwd-slug>/messages/.
project: (note) All communicating agents must run the same updated fa binary version for the unified messaging root to work.
project: (note) flutter_agent root contains install_local.sh that builds and installs fa to ~/.local/bin/fa with ad-hoc macOS code signing.
project: (note) The locally built bundle binary lives at flutter_agent/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah.
project: (note) Cheaper models may fail native tool calling and emit tool-like text instead of actual tool calls.
project: (note) JoinGonka gateway (gate.joingonka.ai) with model moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 supports native tool calling (finish_reason: tool_calls) and works reliably even on large contexts (~100k tokens).
project: (note) The mojibake issue with Cyrillic text (e.g., `ÐÐ»Ð¸...`) is caused by UTF-8 bytes being interpreted as Latin-1 in the display layer, not by the session file itself which is valid UTF-8.
project: (note) Added a `_compactionFailureHint` helper in lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart that catches usage-limit/rate-limit errors and prints a human-readable message pointing to `roles.smol` in ~/.fah/config.yaml.
project: (note) In fa TUI, slash-commands (like /settings) execute immediately even while the agent is streaming, but plain text messages get queued and sent after the current run completes.
project: (note) TUI mouse mode is now auto-detected at startup (TuiMouseMode.auto): it captures the mouse for 500ms and keeps capture only if a wheel event arrives; can be forced with FA_TUI_MOUSE=1 (capture) or FA_TUI_MOUSE=0 (native selection), and toggled at runtime with the `/mouse` slash-command.
project: (note) The TUI history limit was raised from 200 to 2000 lines, and then the hard limit was removed entirely so the full session (loaded from JSONL) is available for scrolling.
project: (note) Dynamic lazy-loading of session history on scroll is not feasible because the markdown formatter is stateful (code fences, tables) — rendering a window requires replaying from the start, so the full formatted buffer is kept in memory instead.
project: (note) Shift+drag is the preferred way to select text in the terminal even when the TUI has captured the mouse for wheel scrolling.
project: (note) CLI media slots vision and transcription must be resolved from models.slots config, not just CLI flags; keys resolved via saved custom providers by matching baseUrl (name-scoped keyName).
project: (note) MiniMax-M3 vision model at api.minimax.io/v1 uses key FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO_MINIMAX (name-scoped custom provider key), not endpoint-scoped FA_KEY_API_MINIMAX_IO.
project: (note) Image/audio/music/video generation tools are NOT in CLI — they live only in Flutter app (media_tools.dart) via MediaGateway, which depends on Flutter-bound MediaModelsStore.
project: (note) AgentTool API changed: uses `parameters` (not `params`), `execute` (not `handler`), `tier` = `ApprovalTier` (not `ToolTier`).
project: (note) Edits to code may be reverted/commented out by others; always verify changes are present and compile before proceeding.
project: (note) Attached images are sent inline to the main chat model (Path 1), NOT through the vision slot — they become part of history and are replayed every turn
project: (note) Vision slot (media_models) is used only by tools like read_video/inspect_image that send frames to a separate endpoint and return only text (Path 2)

Method: per-file patches from the GitHub PR files API (base 59fb4482ce → HEAD dcc6dcff81), cross-checked against full old files (raw.githubusercontent @59fb4482ce) and full new local files. No `part` files involved in this cluster — all extractions are private helpers in the same library, so no part-registration checks apply.

## Findings

### SUGGESTION — dynamic_messages.dart:640 — false doc claim / missed dedup
